verdict.rationale: Workable's docs describe in-product AI suggestions: AI-generated candidate recommendations based on your job ad, AI-assisted candidate search, and a Workable Agent that screens and qualifies candidates against the job spec and returns an interview-ready shortlist. This covers the core of AI-generated suggestions drawn from the user's hiring data. Missing for 10: AI-generated analytics or insights over account data (the custom report builder is not described as AI-driven), detail on how suggestions are explained or surfaced, and any independent or hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
